They were permitted to procure their own bows and arrows, practice martial arts, police one another, and expose villainy and treachery; thus, neighbors within the village gates did not dare violate prohibitions or incur punishment. Even if there were villains standing on tiptoe in eagerness like Robber Zhi (Dao Zhi 盜蹠), they could not have their way. While Anshi's New Policies harmed the people, this particular measure was sound and good, and truly practicable. In the present age it is widely imitated, yet superiors and inferiors deceive one another—it is mere empty paperwork, of no benefit to customs, nor is it universally practiced. We ought to follow his method: appoint chiefs, have each household count its adult males and register them, and periodically inspect their comings and goings so as to restrain their youths and leave villains nowhere to hide; otherwise, all ten households should be held collectively liable. A pact should be made in the village that when bandits arrive, all will join in rescue; those who fail to abide by the pact should be reported to the officials and matched with the appropriate punishment. If this is done, from where could villainy arise, and what worry would there be over bandits? Yet in my humble observation, the present baojia system is not like this: people merely post a placard on their doors for the sake of appearances before the magistrates, and once the officials pass by, they put it away. Therefore it is said: it depends on the men…

title: 萬曆七年浙江鄉試錄
text:
也崔寔曰教化者治平之梁肉刑法者止
病之藥石世皆善其言然愚以爲梁肉雖
美必饜飫而後能養人藥石雖良不浸灌
不能已病豈可未啖一臠而謂梁肉無補
甫嘗一餌而輒求藥石之功乎夫教化法
度亦非一臠一餌之功也計在必行而成
於積久自古及今未有不然者也商君有
言民不可與慮始而可與樂成昔嘗過之
今廼知其切於事情也徒鞅斷於刻礉之
===
===
術耳假令斷於帝王之道豈足過哉書生
之言惟執事擇焉
punctuated: 也。崔寔曰：「教化者，治平之梁肉；刑法者，止病之藥石。」世皆善其言，然愚以爲梁肉雖美，必饜飫而後能養人；藥石雖良，不浸灌不能已病。豈可未啖一臠而謂梁肉無補，甫嘗一餌而輒求藥石之功乎？夫教化法度，亦非一臠一餌之功也。計在必行，而成於積久，自古及今，未有不然者也。商君有言：「民不可與慮始，而可與樂成。」昔嘗過之，今廼知其切於事情也。徒鞅斷於刻礉之術耳，假令斷於帝王之道，豈足過哉？書生之言，惟執事擇焉。
translation_en: … Cui Shi 崔寔 said: "Moral transformation is the fine grain and meat of an era of peace and order; penal law is the medicine and stone needles that cure illness." The world has universally praised his words. Yet in my humble view, although fine grain and meat are delicious, one must eat one's fill of them before they can nourish a person; although medicine and stone needles are effective, unless they are thoroughly administered they cannot cure an illness. How could one claim that fine grain and meat offer no nourishment before having tasted a single slice, or immediately demand the efficacy of medicine and stone needles upon barely sampling a single dose? Indeed, moral transformation and legal institutions are likewise not matters achieved by a single slice or a single dose. The plan lies in resolute implementation, and success comes from long accumulation; from antiquity to the present, it has never been otherwise. Lord Shang 商君 had a saying: "The common people cannot be consulted at the beginning of an undertaking, but one can rejoice with them in its completion." In the past I used to fault this remark, but now I realize how closely it hits the reality of affairs. It is only that Shang Yang 商鞅 applied such decisiveness to harsh and unforgiving techniques; suppose one were to apply that decisiveness to the Way of the Emperors and Kings—how would it deserve any blame? Such are the words of a mere scholar; may Your Excellency choose from among them.

title: 萬曆七年浙江鄉試錄
text:
浙江鄕試錄後序
皇上垂拱之七年巳卯秋八月浙
江舉文學弟子九十人于鄕
令與計偕燕而爲之勸駕節
具官校事用申告于多士曰
皇皇乎文哉綜統道德威儀
人倫經緯羣物潤色專與無
===
所不貫者乎徒腴辭騖說云
爾哉余讀典謨訓誥及於王
風雅頌之篇蓋喟然嘆曰大
哉唐虞三代之文固若此乎
夫其功業登閎與辭命並爛
焉故仲尼之稱陶唐曰巍乎
成功煥乎其文章而美周之
punctuated:
浙江鄕試錄後序

皇上垂拱之七年巳卯秋八月，浙江舉文學弟子九十人于鄕，令與計偕，燕而爲之勸駕。節具官校事，用申告于多士曰：皇皇乎文哉！綜統道德、威儀、人倫，經緯羣物，潤色專與，無所不貫者乎？徒腴辭騖說云爾哉？余讀《典》、《謨》、《訓》、《誥》，及於《王風》、《雅》、《頌》之篇，蓋喟然嘆曰：大哉！唐、虞、三代之文固若此乎！夫其功業登閎，與辭命並爛焉。故仲尼之稱陶唐曰：「巍乎成功，煥乎其文章。」而美周之
translation_en:
Postface to the Record of the Zhejiang Provincial Examination

In the eighth month of autumn of the jimao year, the seventh year of His Majesty's reign of effortless rule (1579), Zhejiang selected ninety students of literature in the Provincial Examination, ordering them to travel to the capital along with the tribute accounts, and held a banquet to speed them on their journey. I, Jie [?], holding office and having overseen the examination affairs, thereupon address the many gentlemen to declare:

How magnificent is literature (wen)! Is it not that which synthesizes and unites the Way and its Virtue, dignified deportment, and human relationships, orders the multitude of things as warp and woof, adorns the specialized [?] and shared [?], and penetrates everything without exception? Or is it merely a matter of rich verbiage and unrestrained disputation? When I read the "Canons," "Counsels," "Instructions," and "Announcements" [of the Book of Documents], down to the "Airs of the Royal Domain," "Odes," and "Hymns" [of the Book of Songs], I sigh with admiration and say: How grand! Was the literature of Tang, Yu, and the Three Dynasties truly like this! Indeed, their achievements and enterprises reached lofty heights and shone brightly alongside their speeches and charges. Thus, when Zhongni (Confucius) praised Tao Tang (Yao), he said: "How lofty were his achievements; how brilliant his cultural patterns (wenzhang)!" And when he praised the Zhou's…

title: 萬曆七年浙江鄉試錄
text:
文以爲郁郁思深哉其指也
今上聰明文武右賢勸學尊仲尼
之教明王道之途
臨御以來屢申使臣廣
勅功令放逐浮淫而奏雅箾海內
學士彬彬嚮風意者靈書八
會玉券十華其當之乎夫四
===
方之風卽四方薦紳先生能
言之矣節辱聘于子大邦言
大邦乎吳越山川鉅麗禹所
從會玉帛誕敷文命者也故
太史公司馬遷弱冠而南遊
上會稽探禹穴以大肆其文
傳述至于今其著世家言咨
punctuated: 文以爲「郁郁」，思深哉其指也！今上聰明文武，右賢勸學，尊仲尼之教，明王道之途。臨御以來，屢申使臣，廣勅功令，放逐浮淫，而奏雅箾。海內學士，彬彬嚮風。意者靈書八會、玉券十華，其當之乎？夫四方之風，卽四方薦紳先生能言之矣。節辱聘于子大邦，言大邦乎？吳、越山川鉅麗，禹所從會玉帛、誕敷文命者也。故太史公司馬遷弱冠而南遊，上會稽，探禹穴，以大肆其文，傳述至于今。其著《世家》言，咨
translation_en:
… culture, he deemed it "rich and resplendent"—how profound in thought was his meaning!

Our reigning Sovereign is sagacious and enlightened, accomplished in both civil and martial arts; he honors the worthy and encourages learning, reveres the teachings of Confucius (Zhongni 仲尼), and illuminates the way of the True King. Since ascending the throne, he has repeatedly instructed his envoys and broadly promulgated the official regulations for the schools and examinations, banishing superficial and extravagant writing so as to sound forth refined music. Scholars throughout the empire, cultivated and accomplished, have turned toward this wind of moral transformation. Might not the "numinous writings in eightfold convergence" and the "jade tallies of tenfold splendor" of legend find their match in this?

As for the customs of the four quarters of the realm, the gentry and elders of those four quarters are well able to speak of them. Since I, [name: Jie 節], have had the undeserved honor of being invited to serve in your great province, shall I speak of your great province? The mountains and rivers of Wu and Yue are vast and magnificent; it was here that Yu the Great assembled the feudal lords with their jade and silk and grandly spread abroad his civilizing mandate. Thus, when the Grand Historian Sima Qian 司馬遷 was twenty years of age, he traveled south, ascended Mount Kuaiji 會稽, and explored the Cave of Yu (Yuxue 禹穴), thereby giving grand expression to his literary power, which has been transmitted down to the present day. In writing his "Hereditary Houses" (Shijia 世家), he sighed in admiration…

title: 萬曆七年浙江鄉試錄
text:
嗟於越以爲有禹之遺烈焉
何其盛也
高皇帝受天命光明函夏
定鼎金陵則吳越之間屬之
畿輔覲光文德斯亦曩時東南
鎬洛也
列聖纘承滲漉鴻涌及乎嘉隆之
===
際緊我
今上至章顯矣今觀其謠俗無論
六藝之士即四民者類無不
勸業務時以脩其能而著名
於天下工斲巧善器商賈善
計然之筴農力田豐年善獲
歲時秔秫之租山海之利錦
punctuated: 嗟於越，以爲有禹之遺烈焉，何其盛也！高皇帝受天命，光明函夏，定鼎金陵，則吳、越之間屬之畿輔，覲光文德，斯亦曩時東南鎬、洛也。列聖纘承，滲漉鴻涌，及乎嘉、隆之際，緊我今上至章顯矣。今觀其謠俗，無論六藝之士，即四民者，類無不勸業務時，以脩其能而著名於天下：工斲巧善器，商賈善計然之筴，農力田、豐年善獲。歲時秔秫之租、山海之利、錦
translation_en:
… sighed in admiration over Yue, considering it to possess the surviving illustrious legacy of Yu—how flourishing it was!

When the Exalted Emperor [Hongwu] received the Mandate of Heaven, bringing brilliance to all within the Chinese realm and establishing the imperial capital at Jinling [Nanjing], the region of Wu and Yue was attached to the metropolitan area. Beholding the radiance of his civilizing virtue, this too was the Hao and Luoyang of the southeast in bygone days. Successive Sacred Emperors continued the line, their grace soaking in deeply and surging forth vastly; down to the Jiajing and Longqing eras, and especially under our Present Reigning Majesty [Wanli], it has become most resplendently manifest.

If we now observe its songs and customs, not to mention the scholars versed in the Six Arts, even among the four classes of the people in general, there are none who do not encourage diligence in their callings and seize the seasons so as to cultivate their abilities and make their names known throughout the empire: artisans carve with skill and excel in making utensils; merchants excel in the calculations of Jiran; farmers work the fields with vigor and reap abundant harvests in good years. At the yearly seasons, the taxes in non-glutinous and glutinous rice, the profits of mountains and seas, and the precious brocades…

title: 萬曆七年浙江鄉試錄
text:
繡機組之貴相屬以貢於
京師而給縣官下者紛詭羨溢
流布四方以共里閭之用士
翩翩然喜文學率循其父兄
長老之敎若饑渴之於食飲
也三歲而貢貢者九十人大
比都試之中
===
制科者常五十人語曰世治百
里而得一賢士比肩也賢者
若此其難也而何越之多才
也
主上以謂諸生吾養之庠序數十
年而拔之數千萬人之中皆
瑰瑋醇茂之士也吾為布之
punctuated: 繡機組之貴，相屬以貢於京師，而給縣官；下者紛詭羨溢，流布四方，以共里閭之用。士翩翩然喜文學，率循其父兄長老之敎，若饑渴之於食飲也。三歲而貢，貢者九十人；大比都試之中制科者，常五十人。語曰：「世治，百里而得一賢，士比肩也。」賢者若此其難也，而何越之多才也！主上以謂：「諸生吾養之庠序數十年，而拔之數千萬人之中，皆瑰瑋醇茂之士也。吾為布之
translation_en:
…the finest of brocades, woven silks, and braided cords follow one upon another as tribute to the capital to supply the imperial court; those of lesser quality, varied and abundant to overflowing, circulate in all directions to meet the needs of the local communities. The scholars, refined and spirited, delight in literature and learning, following the teachings of their fathers, elder brothers, and elders just as the hungry and thirsty crave food and drink. Every three years they are presented for the tribute examination, and ninety men are selected; at the triennial grand competition in the capital [the Metropolitan Examination], those who pass the imperial examination regularly number fifty. The saying goes: "When the world is well-governed, if one worthy is found in every hundred li, scholars are standing shoulder to shoulder." Worthy men are thus so difficult to find—yet how abundant are the talents of Yue [Zhejiang]!

His Majesty considers: "I have nurtured these government students in the local schools for decades and selected them from among tens of thousands; they are all extraordinary, pure, and flourishing scholars. I shall place them…

title: 萬曆七年浙江鄉試錄
text:
中外大者規畫小者錯事賢
知輻湊衆職咸得吾何憂天
下乎惡謂多也豈其使數十
人者被服饜祿以贍妻子徼
榮涂巷而已哉則已多矣諸
生知梓人乎梓人畫宮于堵
依而構之大廈既成不謬尺
===
寸其墨度素定也夫士稱引
古今畫當世亦梓人之圖室
也惟諸生察
上意念所以報
上德者無謬今所稱說惡於梓人
卽
國家甚幸於是九十人者前曰
punctuated: 中外，大者規畫，小者錯事，賢知輻湊，衆職咸得，吾何憂天下乎？惡謂多也！豈其使數十人者，被服饜祿，以贍妻子，徼榮涂巷而已哉？則已多矣。諸生知梓人乎？梓人畫宮于堵，依而構之，大廈既成，不謬尺寸，其墨度素定也。夫士稱引古今，畫當世，亦梓人之圖室也。惟諸生察上意，念所以報上德者，無謬今所稱說，惡於梓人，卽國家甚幸。於是九十人者前曰：
translation_en: … the court and the provinces, with the greater among them formulating grand plans and the lesser handling practical affairs. When the worthy and wise converge like spokes at a hub and all offices find the right men, what worry could I have for the realm? How could they be called too many!’ Could it be that He intends for these several dozen men merely to don official robes and sate themselves on emoluments in order to provide for their wives and children and seek glory in the streets and lanes? If so, then they would already be too many! Do you students know of the master carpenter? The master carpenter draws the plan of a palace upon a wall and builds according to it; when the great edifice is completed, it does not err by a foot or an inch, because his ink-line and measurements were settled beforehand. Now when scholars cite antiquity and the present and map out plans for the contemporary world, that too is like the master carpenter’s drawing of a building. If only you students will discern the Sovereign’s intent, reflect on how to repay the Sovereign’s grace, and not deviate from what you have professed today, thus falling disgracefully short of the master carpenter, then the State will be most fortunate indeed.” Thereupon the ninety men stepped forward and said: …

title: 萬曆七年浙江鄉試錄
text:
唯唯謹受敎願因卒敎諸生
節曰然
國家以六籍敎士而以六籍取
之子佩服六籍足矣余聞之
師云潔淨精微易敎也疏通
知遠書敎也溫柔敦厚詩敎
也恭儉莊敬禮敎也廣博易
===
良樂敎也屬辭比事春秋敎
也夫六敎者非徒設其辭而
已也嫺其辭固將有以服之
其身也士服此六敎者迺可
以列於儒者之林矣是故喬
宇委瑣小言詹詹非易敎也
繁塞苛繞政事糺棼非書敎
punctuated: 「唯唯，謹受敎。願因卒敎諸生。」節曰：「然。國家以六籍敎士，而以六籍取之，子佩服六籍足矣。余聞之師云：『潔淨精微，《易》敎也；疏通知遠，《書》敎也；溫柔敦厚，《詩》敎也；恭儉莊敬，《禮》敎也；廣博易良，《樂》敎也；屬辭比事，《春秋》敎也。』夫六敎者，非徒設其辭而已也；嫺其辭，固將有以服之其身也。士服此六敎者，迺可以列於儒者之林矣。是故喬宇委瑣，小言詹詹，非《易》敎也；繁塞苛繞，政事糺棼，非《書》敎…
translation_en:
“… ‘Yes, yes! We respectfully accept your instruction, and ask that you take this occasion to complete your teaching to us students.’

I (Jie) said: ‘Indeed. The Dynasty educates scholars through the Six Classics and selects them through the Six Classics; for you to take the Six Classics to heart and put them into practice is sufficient. I have heard from the Master: “Purity and subtlety are the teaching of the Changes (Yi); breadth of comprehension and far-reaching vision are the teaching of the Documents (Shu); gentleness, kindness, and sincerity are the teaching of the Odes (Shi); reverence, thrift, gravity, and respect are the teaching of the Rites (Li); expansive breadth and easy goodness are the teaching of the Music (Yue); connecting words and comparing events are the teaching of the Spring and Autumn Annals (Chunqiu).” Now, these six teachings are not merely a matter of setting forth their words; when one is well-versed in their words, one will surely have the means to embody them in one’s own person. Only when a scholar embodies these six teachings may he take his place in the ranks of Confucian scholars. Therefore, being詭異 [?] and petty, with trivial and chattering talk, is not the teaching of the Changes; being bogged down in minutiae and harsh entanglement, throwing affairs of government into knotted confusion, is not the teaching of the Documents…’”

title: 萬曆七年浙江鄉試錄
text:
也齪齪淺中色同意忌非詩
敎也恣睢佚嫚吏固辟違非
禮敎也懁而賊盭和則燕比
非樂敎也是非汶汶倒植臧
否非春秋之敎也故士湛思
竑議鉤玄發藻雲蒸霞變淵
浸川逝而原本道德歸之雅
===
馴六籍之華也言有量衡行
有繩軌內不媿其室外不負
其友祿而使之篤躬壹意以
奉
主上而脩先民之業六籍之質也
夫華諸生旣已采之矣而余
旣睹之矣此豈足當諸生乎
punctuated: 也；齪齪淺中，色同意忌，非《詩》敎也；恣睢佚嫚，吏固辟違，非《禮》敎也；懁而賊盭，和則燕比，非《樂》敎也；是非汶汶，倒植臧否，非《春秋》之敎也。故士湛思竑議，鉤玄發藻，雲蒸霞變，淵浸川逝，而原本道德，歸之雅馴，六籍之華也；言有量衡，行有繩軌，內不媿其室，外不負其友，祿而使之，篤躬壹意以奉主上而脩先民之業，六籍之質也。夫華，諸生旣已采之矣，而余旣睹之矣，此豈足當諸生乎？
translation_en: … [that is not the teaching of the Book of Documents (Shu)]; being narrow-minded and shallow within, agreeing in countenance while harboring jealousy at heart, is not the teaching of the Book of Odes (Shi); being unbridled, dissolute, and arrogant, or being stubbornly perverse and transgressive as an official [?], is not the teaching of the Book of Rites (Li); being急-tempered [?], cruel, and perverse, or when harmonious, being overly familiar and partisan, is not the teaching of the Book of Music (Yue); muddling right and wrong, and inverting praise and blame, is not the teaching of the Spring and Autumn Annals (Chunqiu). Therefore, when scholars engage in deep thought and grand discourse, probing the abstruse and bringing forth literary brilliance—rising like clouds and shifting like rosy mists, steeping like deep pools and flowing on like rivers—while grounding themselves in the Way and its Virtue and returning to refined elegance, this is the flower of the Six Classics. When their words have measure and balance and their conduct follows the marking-line and the wheel-rut, so that within they have nothing to be ashamed of in their own chambers and without they do not fail their friends, and when granted emolument and official employment, they devote themselves wholeheartedly and with single-minded purpose to serving the Sovereign and cultivating the enterprise of the worthy men of old, this is the substance of the Six Classics. Now as for the flower, the students have already plucked it, and I have already witnessed it; yet how could this alone be sufficient to measure up to you students? …

title: 萬曆七年浙江鄉試錄
text:
必且脩其質也諸生僂然曰
鄙儒今迺聞六籍之指廣大
矣請得退而自惟切磋究之
曰然未也將更進焉子曰繪
事後素傳曰衣錦尚絅惡其
文之著也故君子之道闇而
章文在中也今夫日其光全
===
乎内者也故晦明升降不失
其體月之光受之外者也故
盈虧燠寒徇乎時夫日陽道
也月陰道也知陰陽之道則
辨乎人矣是故迅霆揚颺者
氣蕩繁華蔓葉者實衰脩己
者務其根求士者在其内其
punctuated: 必且脩其質也。」諸生僂然曰：「鄙儒今迺聞六籍之指廣大矣，請得退而自惟，切磋究之。」曰：「然，未也，將更進焉。子曰：『繪事後素。』《傳》曰：『衣錦尚絅，惡其文之著也。』故君子之道闇而章，文在中也。今夫日，其光全乎内者也，故晦明升降不失其體；月之光受之外者也，故盈虧燠寒徇乎時。夫日，陽道也；月，陰道也。知陰陽之道，則辨乎人矣。是故迅霆揚颺者氣蕩，繁華蔓葉者實衰。脩己者務其根，求士者在其内。其
translation_en: … You must also cultivate their substance." The students bowed respectfully and said: "We vulgar scholars have only now heard how vast and great the purport of the Six Classics is. Please allow us to withdraw and reflect upon this ourselves, polishing and investigating it together." I replied: "Yes, but that is not all; I shall go even further. The Master said, 'The business of painting comes after the plain groundwork.' The Commentary says, 'Over an embroidered robe one puts a plain garment, disliking the display of its elegance.' Thus the Way of the gentleman is unobtrusive yet becomes ever more illustrious, because his refinement lies within. Now consider the sun: its light is complete within itself, and therefore through darkness and brightness, rising and setting, it never loses its substance. The light of the moon is received from without, and therefore its waxing and waning, warmth and cold follow the seasons. Now the sun is the way of yang; the moon is the way of yin. Once one understands the ways of yin and yang, one can discern men. Therefore, where there is sudden thunder and whipping wind, the vital energy is dissipated; where there are luxuriant blossoms and sprawling leaves, the fruit withers. Those who cultivate themselves attend to their roots; those who seek out scholars look to what is within them. Let us…

title: 萬曆七年浙江鄉試錄
text:
無若秦鄭人昔秦伯嫁女艶
其媵娣晉人貴媵而賤公女
周客賣珠華其櫝鄭人買櫝
而還其珠夫飾其末而亡其
本是嬴伯之棄女也取其外
而遺其内是鄭人之買櫝也
仲尼不云乎聲色末也上天
===
之載無聲無臭至矣夫不大
聲色者固文王之所以為文
也諸生聽之無曰是吾儕童
子所誦說耳夫庸言非卑也
嵬言非深也子反諸其身而
試以徵諸其人儻可信吾言
乎
punctuated: 無若秦、鄭人。昔秦伯嫁女，艶其媵娣，晉人貴媵而賤公女；周客賣珠，華其櫝，鄭人買櫝而還其珠。夫飾其末而亡其本，是嬴伯之棄女也；取其外而遺其内，是鄭人之買櫝也。仲尼不云乎：「聲色，末也。上天之載，無聲無臭，至矣。」夫不大聲色者，固文王之所以為文也。諸生聽之，無曰：「是吾儕童子所誦說耳。」夫庸言非卑也，嵬言非深也，子反諸其身，而試以徵諸其人，儻可信吾言乎！
translation_en: … Let us not be like the men of Qin and Zheng. In antiquity, when the Earl of Qin married off his daughter, he sumptuously adorned her bridesmaids and younger sisters, with the result that the men of Jin prized the bridesmaids and slighted the lord's daughter; when a merchant of Zhou sold a pearl, he lavishly decorated its casket, with the result that a man of Zheng bought the casket and returned the pearl. Now, to embellish the superficial while losing the fundamental is how the Earl of the Ying clan caused his daughter to be spurned; to seize upon the exterior while leaving behind the interior is how the man of Zheng bought the casket. Did Zhongni [Confucius] not say: "Sound and outward appearance are superficial. The workings of High Heaven have neither sound nor odor—that is perfection!" Indeed, not making much of sound and outward appearance was precisely that whereby King Wen was culturally accomplished (wen). Let the students listen to this, and do not say: "This is merely what we used to recite and repeat as boys." For ordinary words are not shallow, nor are lofty words profound. If you reflect upon this within yourselves and try verifying it in others, perhaps you may come to believe my words!

title: 萬曆七年浙江鄉試錄
text:
湖廣承天府荆門州儒學學
正陳節謹序
punctuated: 湖廣承天府荆門州儒學學正陳節謹序。
translation_en: Respectfully prefaced by Chen Jie 陳節, Instructor in the Confucian School of Jingmen Subprefecture, Chengtian Prefecture, Huguang.

title: 萬曆七年浙江鄉試錄
text:
浙江鄉試錄序
萬曆己卯秋浙江當大比士
及期巡按監察御史謝師啓
適至寔綱紀之于時前御史
王曉聘至學正王天策等既
就館而提學僉事喬因阜選
士三千有奇鱗集待試御史
===
曰如故事於是提調則左布
政使勞堪右參政胡定監試
則副使徐元氣吳自新考試
則天策與學正陳節而同考
試則屬之教諭李衡蕭繼庠
周仕堦及訓導魯近智梁鶴
鳴胡誥徐臬王大夔焉御史
punctuated:
浙江鄉試錄序
萬曆己卯秋，浙江當大比士。及期，巡按監察御史謝師啓適至，寔綱紀之。于時，前御史王曉聘至學正王天策等既就館，而提學僉事喬因阜選士三千有奇，鱗集待試。御史曰：「如故事。」於是提調則左布政使勞堪、右參政胡定，監試則副使徐元氣、吳自新，考試則天策與學正陳節，而同考試則屬之教諭李衡、蕭繼庠、周仕堦及訓導魯近智、梁鶴鳴、胡誥、徐臬、王大夔焉。御史
translation_en:
Preface to the Record of the Zhejiang Provincial Examination

In the autumn of the jimao year of the Wanli era (1579), Zhejiang was due to hold the triennial examination of scholars. When the time arrived, Regional Investigating Censor Xie Shiqi 謝師啓 happened to arrive and took overall charge of the proceedings. At that time, Department Director of Schools Wang Tiance 王天策 and others, who had been invited by the former Censor Wang Xiao 王曉, had already taken up residence in the examination quarters, while Education-intendant Assistant Surveillance Commissioner Qiao Yinfu 喬因阜 had selected more than three thousand scholars, who gathered like fish scales awaiting the examination. The Censor said: "Proceed according to precedent." Thereupon, serving as Proctors were Left Administration Commissioner Lao Kan 勞堪 and Right Administration Vice Commissioner Hu Ding 胡定; serving as Surveillance Officials of the Examination were Surveillance Vice Commissioners Xu Yuanqi 徐元氣 and Wu Zixin 吳自新; serving as Examiners were Tiance and Department Director of Schools Chen Jie 陳節; and serving as Associate Examiners were instructors who were District Directors of Schools Li Heng 李衡, Xiao Jixiang 蕭繼庠, and Zhou Shijie 周仕堦, as well as Assistant Instructors Lu Jinzhi 魯近智, Liang Heming 梁鶴鳴, Hu Gao 胡誥, Xu Nie 徐臬, and Wang Dakui 王大夔. The Censor…

title: 萬曆七年浙江鄉試錄
text:
宣言師啓來自
京師
上方採言官建白下禮官議正文
體敦士習冀得真才以裨實
用是在諸執事耳今日事所
不竭誠盡愼稱
上意指者有如
===
天日諸執事敬諾凡再旬竣事得
儁九十人籍氏名與文之優
者爲錄以
獻御史謂天策宜序序曰昔我
高皇帝起南服剖鴻濛而開
日月當是時天造未寧首聘青田
劉基浦江宋濂龍泉章溢麗
punctuated:
宣言：「師啓來自京師，上方採言官建白，下禮官議，正文體，敦士習，冀得真才，以裨實用，是在諸執事耳。今日事，所不竭誠盡愼、稱上意指者，有如天日！」諸執事敬諾。凡再旬竣事，得儁九十人，籍氏名與文之優者爲錄以獻。御史謂天策宜序，序曰：
昔我高皇帝起南服，剖鴻濛而開日月。當是時，天造未寧，首聘青田劉基、浦江宋濂、龍泉章溢、麗
translation_en:
…declared: "I, Shiqi, have just arrived from the capital. His Majesty has recently adopted the proposals of the speaking officials and sent them down to the Ministry of Rites for deliberation, seeking to rectify literary style and cultivate the habits of scholars, in hopes of obtaining genuine talent to be of practical use. This responsibility rests entirely with all of you officiating personnel. In today's undertaking, should anyone fail to exhaust their sincerity and exercise the utmost caution to fulfill His Majesty's intentions, may the sun in Heaven bear witness!" All the officiating personnel respectfully assented. In twenty days the work was completed, and ninety outstanding men were selected. Their surnames and personal names, along with the best of their essays, were compiled into a record to be presented to the throne. The Censor said that I, Tiance, ought to write the preface. My preface states:

In the past, our Emperor Gao [the Hongwu Emperor] arose in the southern regions, cleaving primeval chaos and opening up the sun and moon. At that time, when the imperial enterprise was not yet settled, he first invited Liu Ji (劉基) of Qingtian, Song Lian (宋濂) of Pujiang, Zhang Yi (章溢) of Longquan, and… [Ye Chen of Lishui]

title: 萬曆七年浙江鄉試錄
text:
水葉琛爲置禮賢館稱四先
生
一代人文自此始四先生者皆
浙產也自是海內文章浙斌
斌稱首云
列聖培養餘二百年以至嘉隆之
際文章無慮數變宣弘以前
===
學宗程朱法本韓歐大都不
詭於六經蓋猶有四先生遺
意焉乃後士嘐嘐脩古名愈
引而上實愈趨而下初綴齊
梁其蔽也靡麗而不達旣型
左馬其蔽也剽襲而不融頃
乃出入二氏浸淫百家其蔽
punctuated: 水葉琛，爲置禮賢館，稱「四先生」。一代人文自此始，四先生者，皆浙產也。自是海內文章，浙斌斌稱首云。列聖培養餘二百年，以至嘉、隆之際，文章無慮數變。宣、弘以前，學宗程、朱，法本韓、歐，大都不詭於六經，蓋猶有四先生遺意焉。乃後士嘐嘐脩古，名愈引而上，實愈趨而下。初綴齊、梁，其蔽也靡麗而不達；旣型左、馬，其蔽也剽襲而不融；頃乃出入二氏，浸淫百家，其蔽
translation_en:
…shui, Ye Chen 葉琛, establishing for them the Hall for Honoring the Worthy (Lixian guan 禮賢館) and styling them the "Four Masters." The literary culture of the dynasty began from this, and the Four Masters were all natives of Zhejiang. From that time on, in literary composition within the seas, Zhejiang in its flourishing refinement has been acclaimed first.

Through more than two hundred years of nurturing by the successive sacred emperors down to the Jiajing (1522–1566) and Longqing (1567–1572) eras, literary style has undergone no fewer than several transformations. Before the Xuande (1426–1435) and Hongzhi (1488–1505) eras, scholarship took the Cheng brothers (Cheng Hao 程顥 and Cheng Yi 程頤) and Zhu Xi 朱熹 as its ancestral models, and compositional method was rooted in Han Yu 韓愈 and Ouyang Xiu 歐陽修; for the most part it did not deviate from the Six Classics, and indeed still retained the legacy of the Four Masters. Thereafter, however, scholars grandiloquently cultivated antiquity; the higher they drew their claims in name, the lower they sank in reality. At first they pieced together the styles of the Qi and Liang dynasties, whose defect was being florid yet failing to convey meaning; next they modeled themselves on Zuo Qiuming 左丘明 and Sima Qian 司馬遷, whose defect was plagiarizing without assimilation; and recently they have moved in and out of the Two Teachings (Buddhism and Daoism) and steeped themselves in the Hundred Schools, whose defect…

title: 萬曆七年浙江鄉試錄
text:
也遂詖遁而叛于經一切弁
髦先進務爲宏廓深遠至勦
空寂之敎混敬靜之中崇虛
玄之說加禮法之上是明心
而非格物貴放達而賤持守
内宇宙而外經常先神奇而
後日用彼且糠秕堯舜醯雞
===
周孔芻狗六經何有於四先
生顧其端不知何從而全浙
之士靡然嚮風化肖最速故
海内文章代變以浙爲候夫
浙海壖水國也浙水出三天
子都而委錢塘苕水出天目
而委震澤嚴陵爲桐寶婺姑
punctuated:
也，遂詖遁而叛于經。一切弁髦先進，務爲宏廓深遠。至勦空寂之敎，混敬靜之中；崇虛玄之說，加禮法之上；是明心而非格物，貴放達而賤持守，内宇宙而外經常，先神奇而後日用。彼且糠秕堯、舜，醯雞周、孔，芻狗六經，何有於四先生？顧其端不知何從，而全浙之士靡然嚮風，化肖最速，故海内文章代變，以浙爲候。

夫浙，海壖水國也。浙水出三天子都而委錢塘，苕水出天目而委震澤，嚴陵爲桐，寶婺、姑
translation_en:
… is that they ultimately become biased and evasive, rebelling against the Classics. They utterly cast aside the predecessors like useless caps, striving instead to be vast, sweeping, and abstruse. It reaches the point where they plagiarize teachings of emptiness and quiescence, blending them into reverence and tranquility; they exalt doctrines of void and mystery, placing them above ritual and law; they affirm illuminating the mind while rejecting the investigation of things, prize unbridled freedom while despising steadfast self-restraint, treat the cosmos as internal while dismissing constant norms as external, and put the miraculous first while putting daily practice last. They even treat Yao and Shun as mere husks and chaff, the Duke of Zhou and Confucius as vinegar-gnats, and the Six Classics as straw dogs—so what do the Four Masters matter to them? Yet though one knows not whence this trend originated, the scholars of all Zhejiang have been swept along by the wind, adapting and imitating most rapidly; thus, as literary writing within the seas changes from era to era, Zhejiang serves as the indicator.

Now Zhejiang is a watery land along the coastal marshes. The Zhe River issues from the Capital of the Three Sons of Heaven (Santianzidu) and empties into Qiantang; the Tiao River issues from Mount Tianmu and empties into Lake Zhenze; in Yanling it becomes the Tong River, while around Baowu and Gu…

title: 萬曆七年浙江鄉試錄
text:
蔑焉瀲會稽若耶檇李四明
赤城並海東甌括蒼山溪暎
帶與郡邑錯壤如繡蓋其民
明秀而雅化則水國之恒也
夫欲正文體在敦士習欲求
實用在得真才士習敦則真
才出方今急務
===
上意指所在嚮風而化肖必浙先
也
天子務學躬化於穆清敷布
功令廣厲學官明示以
德意有司者勤宣之士知嚮方天
策幸從諸執事後目披心惟
諸士所稱述率本原經術當
punctuated: 蔑焉瀲，會稽、若耶、檇李、四明、赤城並海，東甌、括蒼山溪暎帶，與郡邑錯壤如繡。蓋其民明秀而雅化，則水國之恒也。夫欲正文體，在敦士習；欲求實用，在得真才。士習敦則真才出，方今急務，上意指所在，嚮風而化肖，必浙先也。天子務學，躬化於穆清，敷布功令，廣厲學官，明示以德意，有司者勤宣之，士知嚮方。天策幸從諸執事後，目披心惟，諸士所稱述，率本原經術，當
translation_en: …Gumie rippling there; Kuaiji, Ruoye, Zuili, Siming, and Chicheng border the sea; the mountains and streams of Dong'ou and Guacang reflect and girdle one another, interlocking with the prefectures and districts like embroidery. Indeed, that its people are bright, refined, and readily transformed by elegance is the constant nature of a land of waters. Now, if one wishes to rectify literary style, it lies in cultivating the habits of the scholars; if one wishes to seek practical utility, it lies in obtaining true talent. When the habits of the scholars are cultivated, true talent emerges. In this urgent task of the present moment, toward which His Majesty's intentions point, in inclining to the wind and being transformed into likeness, Zhejiang will surely be the first. The Son of Heaven devotes himself to learning and personally effects transformation in serene purity; he promulgates the examination regulations and broadly encourages the Confucian school officials, clearly manifesting his virtuous intent. The authorities diligently proclaim it, and the scholars know the direction toward which they should turn. I, Tiance, have had the good fortune to follow behind the various officiating functionaries, perusing with my eyes and pondering in my heart: what the scholars have set forth is generally grounded in classical scholarship, fitting…

title: 萬曆七年浙江鄉試錄
text:
實中竅識達於時務無詖遁
叛經之蔽其最爾雅者庶幾
復見四先生焉天策竊津津
喜語諸執事文體不正乎士
習不敦乎御史曏所爲程督
諸執事者斯殆可以籍手矣
雖然士庶幾者四先生之文
===
耳夫文也豈所以爲四先生
者乎顧文之外天策又安能
知焉昔青田籌畫浦江問學
龍泉麗水政事姑孰公且推
讓焉詩有之鼓鍾于宮聲聞
于外鶴鳴于九皐聲聞于天
四先生者非嘗挾藝自售如
punctuated: 實中竅，識達於時務，無詖遁叛經之蔽。其最爾雅者，庶幾復見四先生焉。天策竊津津喜，語諸執事：「文體不正乎？士習不敦乎？御史曏所爲程督諸執事者，斯殆可以籍手矣。」雖然，士庶幾者，四先生之文耳。夫文也，豈所以爲四先生者乎？顧文之外，天策又安能知焉？昔青田籌畫，浦江問學，龍泉、麗水政事，姑孰公且推讓焉。《詩》有之：「鼓鍾于宮，聲聞于外。」、「鶴鳴于九皐，聲聞于天。」四先生者，非嘗挾藝自售，如
translation_en: …are substantive and hit the mark, with insight reaching into current affairs, free from the blind spots of one-sidedness, evasion, and rebellion against the Classics. In those that are most refined and elegant, one can almost see the Four Masters [Liu Ji 劉基, Song Lian 宋濂, Zhang Yi 章溢, and Ye Chen 葉琛] once again. I, [Su] Tiance 蘇天策, was secretly delighted and said to the various functionaries: "Has the literary style not been rectified? Have the scholars' habits not been made earnest? With this, we now have something in hand to report back on what the Censor previously supervised and required of us functionaries." Even so, what the scholars approximate is merely the writing of the Four Masters. Yet as for writing, how could that alone be what made them the Four Masters? Beyond their writing, however, how could I, Tiance, know of them? In the past, for Qingtian's [Liu Ji's] strategic planning, Pujiang's [Song Lian's] scholarly learning, and Longquan's [Zhang Yi's] and Lishui's [Ye Chen's] governance, even the Duke of Gushu [Tao An 陶安] deferred to them. The Book of Odes (Shi) has it: "Bells are drummed in the palace, and their sound is heard outside"; "The crane cries in the nine marshes, and its voice is heard in heaven." The Four Masters never peddled their skills to promote themselves, like…

title: 萬曆七年浙江鄉試錄
text:
今之比于鄉也宫鼓臯鳴而
聲聞及之士何可以不務實
乎哉諸士進矣使言果可以
得人也
斧扆帷幄造膝披心叅決密謀賛
定大計今玆有青田
細旃廣厦
===
金馬石渠啓沃
聖心潤色
洪業今玆有浦江端臺法從名藩
長吏董正官常周咨民隱今
玆有龍泉麗水
國家所庶幾實用者不必他求
即此有餘用矣不然文雖似
punctuated: 今之比于鄉也。宫鼓臯鳴，而聲聞及之，士何可以不務實乎哉？諸士進矣，使言果可以得人也：斧扆帷幄，造膝披心，叅決密謀，賛定大計，今玆有青田？細旃廣厦，金馬石渠，啓沃聖心，潤色洪業，今玆有浦江？端臺法從，名藩長吏，董正官常，周咨民隱，今玆有龍泉、麗水？國家所庶幾實用者，不必他求，即此有餘用矣。不然，文雖似，
translation_en: … competing in the provincial examinations of today. Like a drum beaten in the palace or a crane crying in the marshes, their renown reached afar—how then can scholars fail to devote themselves to substance? Now that you scholars have advanced, suppose that words truly allow us to obtain worthy men: before the imperial screen and within the tent of command, drawing near the throne to bare one's heart, participating in the resolution of secret counsels and assisting in the settlement of great plans—do we have here today a Qingtian [Liu Ji 劉基]? Upon the fine felt rugs of the spacious lecture halls, at the Golden Horse Gate and the Stone Conduit Pavilion, enlightening and enriching the Sacred Mind and lending luster to the Great Enterprise—do we have here today a Pujiang [Song Lian 宋濂]? In the Censorate and the imperial retinue, or as senior officials in notable provinces, rectifying official norms and thoroughly inquiring into the hidden sufferings of the people—do we have here today a Longquan [Zhang Yi 章溢] or a Lishui [Ye Chen 葉琛]? What the state hopes for by way of practical service need not be sought elsewhere; right here there is more than enough for its use. Otherwise, even if the literary style resembles theirs, …

title: 萬曆七年浙江鄉試錄
text:
才非其真也御史所爲矢天
日而期稱塞者謂何夫地以
人重非能重人科以士重非
能重士毋寧使人謂是科也
真才實用肩相比也踵相接
也夫浙山川未改於昔也而
謂此九十人也者遂無四先
===
生出於其間乎天策等竊望
之矣是舉也總緝文武訓齊
士萌則有巡撫提督軍務右
僉都御史吳善言彰軌示俗
以風譽髦則有巡鹽監察御
史李棟而工部主事胡緒南
京戶部主事馮述武將使屬
punctuated:
才，非其真也。御史所爲矢天日而期稱塞者，謂何？夫地以人重，非能重人；科以士重，非能重士。毋寧使人謂是科也，真才實用，肩相比也，踵相接也。夫浙山川未改於昔也，而謂此九十人也者，遂無四先生出於其間乎？天策等竊望之矣。
是舉也，總緝文武，訓齊士萌，則有巡撫提督軍務右僉都御史吳善言；彰軌示俗，以風譽髦，則有巡鹽監察御史李棟；而工部主事胡緒、南京戶部主事馮述武，將使屬
translation_en:
… [the writings may resemble] talent, yet it is not the genuine article. What then would become of that for which the Censor swore by heaven and the sun, hoping to fulfill his duty? Now, a place gains weight from its people, rather than being able to lend weight to people; an examination gains weight from its scholars, rather than being able to lend weight to scholars. Would it not be better to make people say of this examination that men of true talent and practical utility stand shoulder to shoulder and follow upon one another's heels? The mountains and rivers of Zhejiang have not changed from what they were in the past; can it be said that among these ninety men there will not emerge from their midst figures like the Four Masters? I, Tiance, and my colleagues earnestly hope for this.

In this undertaking, forexercising general supervision over civil and military affairs and instructing and ordering the scholars and commoners, there was the Grand Coordinator and Superintendent of Military Affairs, Right Assistant Censor-in-Chief Wu Shanyan 吳善言; for displaying the norms and guiding customs so as to inspire the distinguished talents, there was the Salt-Control Touring Censor, Investigating Censor Li Dong 李棟; while Secretarial的主事 (Secretary) of the Ministry of Works Hu Xu 胡緒 and Secretary of the Nanjing Ministry of Revenue Feng Shuwu 馮述武 happened to arrive on official missions…

title: 萬曆七年浙江鄉試錄
text:
至胥偕燕喜焉諸圍棘之外
咸勞在公者則右布政使滕
伯輪左叅政張楚城右叅政
王湘右叅議陳詔任惟一副
使陳誥周良臣張希召僉事
須用賔唐本堯署都指揮僉
事蔣木鄧子龍也與勞始事
以
嵩賀行者則左叅議徐廷祼右叅
議張子仁署都指揮僉事莊
重也請書之御史曰如故事
遂書
河南鄭州儒學學正王天策
謹序
punctuated:
至，胥偕燕喜焉。諸圍棘之外，咸勞在公者，則右布政使滕伯輪、左叅政張楚城、右叅政王湘、右叅議陳詔、任惟一、副使陳誥、周良臣、張希召、僉事須用賔、唐本堯、署都指揮僉事蔣木、鄧子龍也；與勞始事、以嵩賀行者，則左叅議徐廷祼、右叅議張子仁、署都指揮僉事莊重也。請書之，御史曰：「如故事。」遂書。
河南鄭州儒學學正王天策謹序。
translation_en:
… happened to arrive, and all shared in the celebratory banquet. As for those outside the thorny walls of the examination compound who all labored in public service, they were Administration Commissioner of the Right Teng Bolun 滕伯輪, Left Administration Vice Commissioner Zhang Chucheng 張楚城, Right Administration Vice Commissioner Wang Xiang 王湘, Right Assistant Administration Commissioners Chen Zhao 陳詔 and Ren Weiyi 任惟一, Surveillance Vice Commissioners Chen Gao 陳誥, Zhou Liangchen 周良臣, and Zhang Xizhao 張希召, Assistant Surveillance Commissioners Xu Yongbin 須用賔 and Tang Benyao 唐本堯, and Acting Assistant Regional Military Commissioners Jiang Mu 蔣木 and Deng Zilong 鄧子龍; and as for those who shared in the labors at the inception of the affair and then departed to offer imperial birthday congratulations, they were Left Assistant Administration Commissioner Xu Tingguan 徐廷祼, Right Assistant Administration Commissioner Zhang Ziren 張子仁, and Acting Assistant Regional Military Commissioner Zhuang Zhong 莊重. When asked whether to record their names, the Censor said, "Follow precedent." And so they have been recorded.

Respectfully prefaced by Wang Tiance 王天策, Confucian School Director of Zhengzhou 鄭州 in Henan 河南.

title: 萬曆七年浙江鄉試錄
text:
第壹場
四書
士不可以不弘毅任重而道遠
質諸鬼神而無疑知天也百世以俟聖人
而不惑知人也是故君子動而世爲天
下道行而世爲天下法言而世爲天下
則遠之則有望近之則不厭
賢者在位能者在職國家閒暇及是時明
其政刑雖大國必畏之矣詩云迨天之
===
未陰雨徹彼桑土綢繆牖戶今此下民
或敢侮予孔子曰爲此詩者其知道乎
能治其國家誰敢侮之
易
天地養萬物聖人養賢以及萬民頤之時
大矣哉
九二之孚有喜也
夫易聖人所以崇德而廣業也知崇禮卑
崇效天卑法地
punctuated:
第壹場

四書

士不可以不弘毅，任重而道遠。
質諸鬼神而無疑，知天也；百世以俟聖人而不惑，知人也。是故君子動而世爲天下道，行而世爲天下法，言而世爲天下則。遠之則有望，近之則不厭。
賢者在位，能者在職，國家閒暇，及是時，明其政刑，雖大國，必畏之矣。《詩》云：「迨天之未陰雨，徹彼桑土，綢繆牖戶。今此下民，或敢侮予？」孔子曰：「爲此詩者，其知道乎！能治其國家，誰敢侮之！」

易

天地養萬物，聖人養賢以及萬民，頤之時大矣哉！
九二之孚，有喜也。
夫《易》，聖人所以崇德而廣業也。知崇禮卑，崇效天，卑法地。
translation_en:
First Session

Four Books

A scholar-gentleman cannot but be broad-minded and resolute, for his burden is heavy and his road is long. [Analects 8.7]

Presenting them before ghosts and spirits without doubt shows that one knows Heaven; waiting a hundred generations for a sage without perplexity shows that one knows men. Therefore, when the noble man moves, for generations he serves as the Way of the world; when he acts, for generations he serves as a model for the world; when he speaks, for generations he serves as a standard for the world. Those who are distant look up to him with hope; those who are near do not grow weary of him. [Doctrine of the Mean 29]

If men of virtue hold the positions of authority and men of ability occupy the offices, and when the state is at leisure, one takes advantage of this time to make clear its governance and penal laws, then even great states will surely stand in awe of it. The Book of Odes (Shi) says: "Before the sky darkens with rain, I strip away that mulberry root-bark and bind fast the windows and doors. Now among the people below, who would dare insult me?" Confucius said: "Did not the maker of this ode understand the Way! If one is able to govern his state and family, who will dare insult him?" [Mencius 2A.4]

Book of Changes (Yi)

Heaven and earth nourish the myriad things; the sage nourishes the worthy so as to reach the myriad people. Great indeed is the timely significance of Nourishment (Yi)! [Commentary on the Decision, Hexagram 27, Yi]

The sincerity of the Nine in the Second place brings cause for joy. [Commentary on the Images, Hexagram 58, Dui]

Now the Changes is that whereby the sages exalted their virtue and broadened their enterprise. Wisdom is exalted and ritual is humble: the exalted emulates Heaven, and the humble takes earth as its model. [Appended Remarks (Xici), Part I, Ch. 7]

title: 萬曆七年浙江鄉試錄
text:
乾以君之
書
帝曰來禹汝亦昌言禹拜曰都帝予何言
予思日孜孜
九州攸同四隩旣宅九山刊旅九川滌源
九澤旣陂四海會同
不役耳目百度惟貞
唐虞稽古建官惟百內有百揆四岳外有
州牧侯伯庶政惟和萬國咸寧夏商官
===
倍亦克用乂明王立政不惟其官惟其
人
詩
羔裘豹飾孔武有力彼其之子邦之司直
羔裘晏兮三英粲兮彼其之子邦之彦
兮
旣齊旣稷旣匡旣敕
思齊大任文王之母思媚周姜京室之婦
大姒嗣徽音則百斯男
punctuated:
乾以君之。

《書》：
帝曰：「來！禹，汝亦昌言。」禹拜曰：「都！帝，予何言？予思日孜孜。」
九州攸同，四隩旣宅，九山刊旅，九川滌源，九澤旣陂，四海會同。
不役耳目，百度惟貞。
唐虞稽古，建官惟百；內有百揆四岳，外有州牧侯伯，庶政惟和，萬國咸寧。夏商官倍，亦克用乂。明王立政，不惟其官，惟其人。

《詩》：
羔裘豹飾，孔武有力。彼其之子，邦之司直。羔裘晏兮，三英粲兮。彼其之子，邦之彦兮。
旣齊旣稷，旣匡旣敕。
思齊大任，文王之母，思媚周姜，京室之婦。大姒嗣徽音，則百斯男。
translation_en:
"Qian acts as ruler over them."

Book of Documents (Shu):
"The Emperor said, 'Come, Yu! Do you also utter splendid words.' Yu bowed and said, 'Oh! Emperor, what can I say? I think only of being diligent day by day.'"
"Throughout the Nine Provinces a similar order was effected: the grounds along the waters in the four quarters were made habitable; the hills of the Nine Provinces were cleared of wood and opened up for sacrifice and travel; the sources of the streams of the Nine Provinces were dredged; the marshes of the Nine Provinces were banked cleanly; and all within the Four Seas had access to the capital."
"Do not be enslaved by your ears and eyes, and then all your measures will be贞 [correct]."
"Tang and Yu examined antiquity and established a hundred offices. At court there were the General Regulator and the Four Mountains; outside there were the Pastors of the Provinces and the Ruling Princes and Earls. Thus the various departments of government went on harmoniously, and the myriad states all enjoyed repose. Under the Xia and Shang dynasties the number of offices was doubled, and they were still able to maintain good governance. Intelligent kings, in establishing their government, cared not so much about the number of offices as about the men."

Book of Odes (Shi):
"Lamb's fur, with leopard's-skin cuffs, very martial and strong! That man there is the maintainer of rectitude in the state. Lamb's fur, splendid, with the three ornaments gleaming! That man there is the ornament of the state!"
"You have been exact and expeditious; you have been upright and cautious."
"Reverent was Tai Ren, the mother of King Wen; lovingly did she demean herself toward Zhou Jiang—a wife in the capital house. Tai Si inherited her excellent fame, and of her were born a hundred sons."

title: 萬曆七年浙江鄉試錄
text:
薄言震之莫不震疊懷柔百神及河喬嶽
春秋
春齊侯宋人陳人蔡人邾人會于北杏〔莊〕
〔公十有三年〕夏六月公會齊侯宋公陳
侯鄭伯同盟于幽〔莊公二十有七年〕
晉人陳人鄭人伐許〔僖公三十有三年〕
冬十有二月戊午晉人秦人戰于河曲〔文〕
〔公十有二年〕夏六月乙卯晉荀林父帥
師及楚子戰于邲晉師敗績〔宣公十有〕
===
〔二年〕夏四月叔孫豹會晉荀偃齊人宋
人衛北宮括鄭公孫蠆曹人莒人邾人
滕人薛人杞人小邾人伐秦〔襄公十有〕
〔四年〕
公會晉侯及吳子于黃池〔哀公十有三年〕
禮記
凡居民材必因天地寒煖燥濕廣谷大川
異制民生其間者異俗剛柔輕重遲速
異齊五味異和器械異制衣服異宜脩
punctuated:
薄言震之，莫不震疊。懷柔百神，及河喬嶽。

《春秋》
春，齊侯、宋人、陳人、蔡人、邾人會于北杏。〔莊公十有三年〕夏六月，公會齊侯、宋公、陳侯、鄭伯同盟于幽。〔莊公二十有七年〕
晉人、陳人、鄭人伐許。〔僖公三十有三年〕
冬十有二月戊午，晉人、秦人戰于河曲。〔文公十有二年〕夏六月乙卯，晉荀林父帥師及楚子戰于邲，晉師敗績。〔宣公十有二年〕夏四月，叔孫豹會晉荀偃、齊人、宋人、衛北宮括、鄭公孫蠆、曹人、莒人、邾人、滕人、薛人、杞人、小邾人伐秦。〔襄公十有四年〕
公會晉侯及吳子于黃池。〔哀公十有三年〕

《禮記》
凡居民材，必因天地寒煖燥濕，廣谷大川異制。民生其間者異俗：剛柔、輕重、遲速異齊，五味異和，器械異制，衣服異宜。脩
translation_en:
When he shakes them with his awe, there is none who does not tremble in submission. He conciliates and soothes all the spirits, even to those of the Yellow River and the lofty mountains.

Spring and Autumn Annals (Chunqiu)
"In spring, the Marquis of Qi, an officer of Song, an officer of Chen, an officer of Cai, and an officer of Zhu met at Beixing." [Thirteenth year of Duke Zhuang] "In summer, in the sixth month, the Duke met the Marquis of Qi, the Duke of Song, the Marquis of Chen, and the Earl of Zheng, and together they made a covenant at You." [Twenty-seventh year of Duke Zhuang]
"Men of Jin, men of Chen, and men of Zheng invaded Xu." [Thirty-third year of Duke Xi]
"In winter, in the twelfth month, on the wuwu day, the men of Jin and the men of Qin fought at Hequ." [Twelfth year of Duke Wen] "In summer, in the sixth month, on the yimao day, Xun Linfu 荀林父 of Jin led an army and fought with the Viscount of Chu at Bi; the army of Jin was utterly routed." [Twelfth year of Duke Xuan] "In summer, in the fourth month, Shusun Bao 叔孫豹 joined Xun Yan 荀偃 of Jin, an officer of Qi, an officer of Song, Beigong Kuo 北宮括 of Wei, Gongsun Chai 公孫蠆 of Zheng, an officer of Cao, an officer of Ju, an officer of Zhu, an officer of Teng, an officer of Xue, an officer of Qi, and an officer of Little Zhu in invading Qin." [Fourteenth year of Duke Xiang]
"The Duke met the Marquis of Jin and the Viscount of Wu at Huangchi." [Thirteenth year of Duke Ai]

Record of Rites (Liji)
"In all cases of settling the people and assessing their capacities, one must take into account the cold and warmth, dryness and moisture of Heaven and Earth. Broad valleys and great rivers have different configurations, and the people born among them have different customs: their temperaments—whether unyielding or pliant, volatile or grave, slow or quick—are differently balanced; the five flavors are differently blended; implements and utensils are differently fashioned; clothing has different suitabilities. One cultivates..."

punctuated:
其敎不易其俗，齊其政不易其宜。
是故情見而義立，樂終而德尊。
《詩》云：「豐水有芑，武王豈不仕？詒厥孫謀，以燕翼子。」數世之仁也。
敎順成俗，外內和順，國家理治，此之謂盛德。

第貳場
論
古之學者爲己

詔、誥、表〔內科一道〕
擬漢賜民今年田租之半詔〔文帝二年〕
擬唐以左僕射房玄齡爲太子少師誥〔貞觀十三年〕
擬虜酋俺答率西夷烏思藏鎖南堅參等求貢方物羣臣賀表〔萬曆七年〕

判語〔五條〕
translation_en:
…cultivated their teachings without changing their customs, and regulated their governance without changing what was suitable to them.
Therefore, when feelings are made manifest, righteousness is established; when the music is brought to its conclusion, virtue is revered.
The Book of Odes says: "By the Feng River there is white millet; how could King Wu not have had employment? He bequeathed his plans to his descendants, to give comfort and support to his son." This was benevolence extending through several generations.
When instruction is compliant and forms customs, when outside and inside are harmonious and compliant, and the state and family are well-ordered, this is called flourishing virtue.

Second Session
Discourse
"The scholars of antiquity learned for themselves."

Proclamation, Mandate, and Memorial [examinees are to answer one]

title: 萬曆七年浙江鄉試錄
text:
官員襲廕
磨勘卷宗
荒蕪田地
優恤軍屬
帶造段疋
第叄場
策五道
問王者假廟追崇祖考以廣孝思至鉅典
也蓋廟有時享有大祫位祝稱配倫紀
===
攸崇可不斤斤理順易則哉我
太祖高皇帝建
廟闕左崇
四親侑以
壽春諸王
成祖文皇帝建
廟北平崇
太祖
四親侑進如之因親及親世祝稱配章明矣
punctuated:
官員襲廕。
磨勘卷宗。
荒蕪田地。
優恤軍屬。
帶造段疋。

第叄場
策五道

問：王者假廟追崇祖考，以廣孝思，至鉅典也。蓋廟有時享、有大祫，位祝稱配，倫紀攸崇，可不斤斤理順易則哉？我太祖高皇帝建廟闕左，崇四親，侑以壽春諸王；成祖文皇帝建廟北平，崇太祖、四親，侑進如之。因親及親，世祝稱配，章明矣。
translation_en:
Hereditary Privilege and Protection for Officials.
Review and Audit of Case Dossiers.
Uncultivated and Abandoned Farmland.
Compassionate Relief for Military Dependents.
Supplementary Weaving of Satin Bolts.

Third Session
Five Policy Questions

Question: That a true king draws near to the ancestral temple and posthumously honors his ancestors and deceased father in order to broaden his filial thoughts is the most momentous of state canons. Now, in the ancestral temple there are the seasonal sacrifices and the grand collective sacrifice; the placement of spirit tablets, the liturgical invocations, and the designation of配享 (associate recipients of sacrifice) are whereby human relationships and generational order are exalted—how could one not be scrupulously attentive to making their principle harmonious and their rules clear and easy to follow? Our Grand Progenitor, Emperor Gao (Taizu, r. 1368–1398), established the ancestral temple to the left of the palace gates, honoring his four immediate ancestors and associating with them in sacrifice the Prince of Shouchun and the other princes; the Accomplished Ancestor, Emperor Wen (Chengzu, r. 1402–1424), established the ancestral temple in Beiping, honoring the Grand Progenitor and the four immediate ancestors, and advancing the associate recipients in the same manner. Extending affection from one's nearest kin to further kin, the generational invocations and designations of associates in sacrifice were thus made brilliantly clear. …

title: 萬曆七年浙江鄉試錄
text:
列聖繼承誕章軌屬
憲宗純皇帝時已備
九廟至
世宗肅皇帝特進
獻考其時祫之禮或推自
太祖而上或斷自
太祖而下有祧無祧特享合享儻可得詳與且
九廟祀先制備矣迺時享祝辭間稱
八廟六廟五廟至已列六廟而猶仍五廟之稱
===
世次名義其於何乃歲暮
大祫祧廟咸升而以
壽春十五王配享議者謂諸王於
太祖爲伯爲兄爲姪而槩稱
皇曾伯祖順乎今位次孰當緒正
徽號孰當通列稱謂宜如何頃議下掌故具
上裁定之昭夏幽鬯垂之千億諸生宜悉著其
義而覽焉
問傳有之衆言淆亂折諸聖今之世去聖
punctuated:
列聖繼承，誕章軌屬。憲宗純皇帝時，已備九廟；至世宗肅皇帝，特進獻考。其時祫之禮，或推自太祖而上，或斷自太祖而下，有祧無祧，特享合享，儻可得詳與？且九廟祀先，制備矣；迺時享祝辭，間稱八廟、六廟、五廟，至已列六廟而猶仍五廟之稱，世次名義其於何？乃歲暮大祫，祧廟咸升，而以壽春十五王配享。議者謂諸王於太祖爲伯、爲兄、爲姪，而槩稱皇曾伯祖，順乎？今位次孰當緒正？徽號孰當通列？稱謂宜如何？頃議下掌故，具上裁定之，昭夏幽鬯，垂之千億。諸生宜悉著其義而覽焉。
問：傳有之：「衆言淆亂，折諸聖。」今之世去聖
translation_en:
As the successive Sacred Emperors inherited the throne, they grandly manifested the proper norms and lineages. By the time of Emperor Xianzong Chun (the Chenghua Emperor), the Nine Ancestral Temples were already complete; when it came to Emperor Shizong Su (the Jiajing Emperor), he specially elevated his Imperial Deceased Father Xian (Rui Zong). Regarding the seasonal and collective sacrifice (xia) rites at that time—whether traced upward from Taizu or demarcated downward from Taizu, whether involving removal to distant shrines (tiao) or not, and whether conducted as individual sacrifices or joint sacrifices—can these be recounted in detail? Furthermore, in sacrificing to the ancestors in the Nine Temples, the institution was complete; yet the ritual prayers for the seasonal sacrifices occasionally referred to Eight Temples, Six Temples, or Five Temples, and even when Six Temples had already been arrayed, the designation of Five Temples was still retained—how does this accord with generational order and nominal meaning [?]? Moreover, in the Great Collective Sacrifice (da xia) at the end of the year, the spirits from the removed shrines (tiao miao) all ascend to join the feast, while the Prince of Shouchun and the other fourteen princes enjoy associate sacrifices (peixiang). Discussants argue that since these princes stood in relation to Taizu as uncles, elder brothers, or nephews, is it fitting to uniformly address them all in prayer as "Imperial Great-Grand-Uncles" (Huang Zengbozu)? Today, which tablet placements ought to be rectified in sequence? Which honorific titles ought to be comprehensively arrayed? And what should the forms of address properly be? Recently, deliberations were sent down to the ritual authorities (zhanggu) and fully presented to His Majesty for final decision, so as to illuminate the realm and harmonize the unseen spirits, passing this down for myriad generations. You students should fully set forth the principles of this matter for our inspection.

Question: There is a saying in the commentaries: "When the multitude of words are confused and disorderly, refer them to the Sage for judgment." The present age is far removed from the…

title: 萬曆七年浙江鄉試錄
text:
人遠矣竅言聿興塗塞耳目後生遞相
聞習愈益滅眞將安所折衷乎卽如孔
子自生民以來未有盛焉者也乃莊列
諸家極其詆訾而遷史信之一何無擇
之甚與試舉其一二商核焉正考父銘
鼎之詞與徵在禱於尼丘之事並著孔
子世家而聊曼父之母防山之反告則
檀弓備載之三都之墮夾谷之會信所
以存魯也假令其所以折衝之策第如
===
左氏所稱說亦殊不類哉亟見老聃盜
跖之徒輒至自失抑何憊也遇少源阿
谷之婦不厭與言毋乃瀆乎學琴師襄
何以遂見文王登泰山之巔何以望見
吳門之馬六尺之杖何以别親疎之倫
一飯之桃何以定貴賤之等狸歌原壤
曷弗絕之請討陳恒又奚校量焉以至
占桓僖之廟災誡始皇以遺讖萍實商
羊之異與夫黑牛白犢之生何其言盡
punctuated: 人遠矣。竅言聿興，塗塞耳目，後生遞相聞習，愈益滅眞，將安所折衷乎？卽如孔子，自生民以來未有盛焉者也。乃莊、列諸家極其詆訾，而遷史信之，一何無擇之甚與？試舉其一二商核焉。正考父銘鼎之詞，與徵在禱於尼丘之事，並著《孔子世家》；而聊曼父之母、防山之反告，則《檀弓》備載之。三都之墮、夾谷之會，信所以存魯也，假令其所以折衝之策，第如左氏所稱說，亦殊不類哉！亟見老聃、盜跖之徒，輒至自失，抑何憊也！遇少源、阿谷之婦，不厭與言，毋乃瀆乎？學琴師襄，何以遂見文王？登泰山之巔，何以望見吳門之馬？六尺之杖，何以别親疎之倫？一飯之桃，何以定貴賤之等？狸歌原壤，曷弗絕之？請討陳恒，又奚校量焉？以至占桓、僖之廟災，誡始皇以遺讖，萍實、商羊之異，與夫黑牛、白犢之生，何其言盡
translation_en: … the Sages is far removed. Specious words have arisen to stop up people's ears and eyes; as later generations pass them down and study them in turn, the truth is increasingly obliterated. Where, then, shall we turn for a balanced judgment? Take Confucius (Kongzi 孔子), for instance: since the birth of mankind, there has never been anyone greater than he. Yet the schools of Zhuangzi (莊子) and Liezi (列子) slandered and disparaged him to the utmost, and Sima Qian's history (Qianshi 遷史) believed them—how could it be so utterly indiscriminate? Let us cite one or two examples to examine and verify this. The words of Zheng Kaofu's (正考父) tripod inscription and the affair of Yan Zhengzai (徵在) praying at Mount Niqiu (尼丘) are both recorded in the "Hereditary House of Confucius" (Kongzi shijia 孔子世家); meanwhile, the mother of Liao Manfu (聊曼父) and the report of the collapse at Mount Fang (防山) are fully recounted in the "Tangong" (檀弓) chapter. The dismantling of the three capitals and the meeting at Jiagu (夾谷) were truly the means by which Lu (魯) was preserved; yet even supposing that his strategies for repelling the enemy were merely as Mr. Zuo (Zuoshi 左氏) describes, how utterly out of character that would be! When he repeatedly met with the likes of Lao Dan (老聃) and Robber Zhi (Dao Zhi 盜跖), he was always left disconcerted and at a loss—how exhausted he seems! When he encountered the women of Shaoyuan (少源) and Agu (阿谷) and did not tire of speaking with them, was that not an impropriety? In learning the zither from Music Master Xiang (Shi Xiang 師襄), how did he come to see King Wen (Wen Wang 文王) right before him? Climbing to the summit of Mount Tai (泰山), how could he gaze out and see a horse at the gate of Wu (吳門)? With a six-chi staff, how did he distinguish the degrees of kinship and distance? With the peaches served at a meal, how did he determine the ranks of noble and base? When Yuan Rang (原壤) sang the song of the wildcat, why did he not sever relations with him? In requesting permission to punish Chen Heng (陳恒), why would he have calculated the relative strength of forces? And when it comes to divining the fire at the temples of Dukes Huan (桓) and Xi (僖), warning the First Emperor (Shihuang 始皇) through a prophetic inscription left behind, the anomalies of the duckweed fruit and the one-legged shangyang (商羊) bird, as well as the birth of a white calf from a black cow—how is it that his words were all…

title: 萬曆七年浙江鄉試錄
text:
有徵而土精之恠專車之骨肅慎氏之
矢即又一一物色之是果盡出于孔子
與抑亦好事者為之無足稽也夫李由
傳誣子順變色瘠環蜚語孟子抗辭諸
生誦法孔子不宜嘿嘿任其哆言無當
而已試相與辨難之
問
國家之於需才至勤矣今歳大比當計羣吏
又進子大夫令與計偕凡以辨材而用
===
之也吾遂與子言辨材之方焉古者稱
人之賢通謂之才今考其所數為材者
率德行也或以德稱而其所列為德又
多材能之號蓋仲尼孟子之說書記所
稱高陽高辛氏之類可睹已自材德分
之說出而諸儒百家言人人殊矣有云
才下而德尊者有曰德易而才難者其
說何遵有云以德為目以材自名者有
曰德立則五才無殆五見則德無位者
punctuated:
有徵，而土精之恠、專車之骨、肅慎氏之矢，即又一一物色之。是果盡出于孔子與？抑亦好事者為之，無足稽也？夫李由傳誣，子順變色；瘠環蜚語，孟子抗辭。諸生誦法孔子，不宜嘿嘿任其哆言無當而已，試相與辨難之。

問：國家之於需才至勤矣。今歳大比，當計羣吏，又進子大夫，令與計偕，凡以辨材而用之也。吾遂與子言辨材之方焉。古者稱人之賢，通謂之才，今考其所數為材者，率德行也；或以德稱，而其所列為德，又多材能之號。蓋仲尼、孟子之說，書記所稱高陽、高辛氏之類，可睹已。自材德分之說出，而諸儒百家，言人人殊矣。有云「才下而德尊」者，有曰「德易而才難」者，其說何遵？有云「以德為目，以材自名」者，有曰「德立則五才無殆，五見則德無位」者，
translation_en:
…are verified, while he also identified one by one such anomalies as the earth-spirit monster (Fenyang), the bone large enough to fill a cart, and the arrow of the Sushen clan! Did all of these truly originate from Confucius? Or were they fabricated by sensation-seekers and unworthy of investigation? Now, when Li You passed on slanders, Zishun (Kong Bin) changed countenance; when unfounded rumors circulated about Jihuan, Mencius vigorously refuted them. You students who recite and model yourselves on Confucius ought not remain silent and merely allow such extravagant and unfounded talk to go unchallenged. Try to debate and resolve these questions together.

Question: The state is exceedingly diligent in its search for talent. This year, at the great triennial examination, when the mass of officials are to be evaluated, you gentlemen are also brought forward and ordered to travel together with the local reporting delegates to the capital—all in order to discern talent and employ it. I shall therefore speak with you about the methods of discerning talent. In antiquity, when praising a person's worthiness, it was generally called "talent" (cai 才); yet when we examine today what they enumerated as talent, it was mostly moral conduct (dexing 德行). Conversely, sometimes people were praised for "virtue" (de 德), yet what they listed as virtue often consisted of designations for talent and ability. Indeed, this can be seen in the sayings of Confucius (Zhongni) and Mencius, as well as in what the historical records recount of the clans of Gaoyang and Gaoxin. Ever since the theory separating talent and virtue emerged, the various Confucians and Hundred Schools have each held different views. Some say that "talent is inferior while virtue is exalted," and others say that "virtue is easy while talent is difficult"—which view should be followed? Some say that "virtue is the overarching category while talent gives each its specific name," and others say that "when virtue is established, the five talents are free from peril, whereas when the five are displayed, virtue has no place"—…

title: 萬曆七年浙江鄉試錄
text:
其義何稱於是方人者則曰某也德某
也才上德者曰與才有餘而德不足也
不若才不足而德有餘也而喜才者又
曰與其德勝於才也毋寧才勝德一人
之身異指殊好豈才德誠兩端乎意者
今之所謂才德非古之才德與將後世
之衡鏡亦與古異也吾觀今之好惡取
舍亦多岐矣若是而胡能無賣璞之誚
也又將無有懷璞而不能自明者乎夫
===
儒者持論要於其當固不可膠守舊聞
以耳食也吾甞聞說劔相馬之術而得
相人之道焉今當與諸生究之共由大
道也
問氏族之敎遐哉尚矣古者因族立宗因
宗系姓重本之士靡不家聯戶比繩繩
而世守之烏睹所稱譜牒云迺近世宗
法廢而天下無世家司馬氏覽觀往古
始作帝紀述世家而議譜者往往宗焉
punctuated:
其義何稱？於是方人者則曰：「某也德，某也才。」上德者曰：「與才有餘而德不足也，不若才不足而德有餘也。」而喜才者又曰：「與其德勝於才也，毋寧才勝德。」一人之身，異指殊好，豈才德誠兩端乎？意者今之所謂才德，非古之才德與？將後世之衡鏡，亦與古異也？吾觀今之好惡取舍，亦多岐矣。若是，而胡能無賣璞之誚也？又將無有懷璞而不能自明者乎？夫儒者持論，要於其當，固不可膠守舊聞，以耳食也。吾甞聞說劔、相馬之術，而得相人之道焉。今當與諸生究之，共由大道也。
問：氏族之敎，遐哉尚矣！古者因族立宗，因宗系姓，重本之士，靡不家聯戶比，繩繩而世守之，烏睹所稱譜牒云？迺近世宗法廢，而天下無世家。司馬氏覽觀往古，始作帝紀，述世家，而議譜者往往宗焉。
translation_en:
… what is the meaning they express? Thereupon, those who evaluate men say: "Such-and-such a person has virtue; such-and-such a person has talent." Those who prize virtue say: "Rather than having a surplus of talent and a deficiency of virtue, it is better to have a deficiency of talent and a surplus of virtue." Yet those who favor talent say in turn: "Rather than virtue surpassing talent, it is better for talent to surpass virtue." Within the person of a single individual, pointers differ and preferences diverge—are talent and virtue truly two separate extremes? Could it be that what are called talent and virtue today are not the talent and virtue of antiquity? Or is it that the scales and mirrors of later ages also differ from those of antiquity? As I observe the likes, dislikes, selections, and rejections of the present day, they too diverge into many paths. Being thus, how can one avoid the ridicule of selling an uncarvedrat [as jade, i.e., *maipu* 賣璞]? And will there not also be those who clasp an uncut jade in their bosom yet are unable to make themselves understood? Now, when Confucian scholars maintain a discourse, the essential point is that it be appropriate; they certainly must not stubbornly cling to old hearsay and feed merely on what they hear with their ears. I have heard of the arts of discussing swords and physiognomizing horses, and from them have grasped the way of judging men. Today I ought to investigate this thoroughly with you students, that we may together follow the Great Way.

Question: Teaching regarding lineages and clans reaches back to remote antiquity indeed! In ancient times, on the basis of clans, ancestral lineages were established, and on the basis of ancestral lineages, surnames were linked together. Gentlemen who valued their roots without exception joined their families and aligned their households, preserving them continuously from generation to generation—where did one ever see what are called genealogical registers (*pudie*)? Yet in recent ages the patriarchal clan system (*zongfa*) fell into disuse, and the empire had no hereditary houses (*shijia*). Master Sima [Sima Qian 司馬遷], surveying the past and antiquity, first composed the Basic Annal of the Emperors (*diji*) and recounted the Hereditary Houses (*shijia*), and those who discuss genealogies have often taken him as their standard. …

title: 萬曆七年浙江鄉試錄
text:
故漢譜萬姓並篇氏族魏立中正爰置
九品晉宋以後競相崇重百家有譜百
官有牒官氏有志至李唐尤盛矣氏族
姓系志錄並垂衣冠永泰篇目繁侈而
韻略韻譜又以聲辨族諸若此類議者
多有所是非以余所聞譜牒家言毋亦
有所祖述乎何其與古謬盭也君子慨
然思古宗法而勢不可行矣故於譜牒
致意焉昔宋世言宗譜者二家曰廬陵
===
歐陽氏曰眉山蘇氏今其法綦然覈也
亦可倣而行之否多士慕古昔而尊本
源懷敦睦之思幸爲我言其槩
問天下之法久則必敝敝則必通其變變
通所以救敝也然敝或從生焉然則法
終不可變乎利害得失固相倚伏而不
可絕乎將翟翦所謂舉大木者乎抑用
餡者之殊乎智者之所以搤掔深思諏
咨而求也往者畫里輪年而事民民患
punctuated:
故漢譜《萬姓》，並篇《氏族》；魏立中正，爰置九品；晉、宋以後，競相崇重。《百家》有譜，《百官》有牒，《官氏》有志。至李唐尤盛矣，《氏族》《姓系》，志錄並垂，《衣冠》《永泰》，篇目繁侈，而《韻略》《韻譜》，又以聲辨族。諸若此類，議者多有所是非。以余所聞，譜牒家言，毋亦有所祖述乎？何其與古謬盭也！君子慨然思古宗法，而勢不可行矣，故於譜牒致意焉。昔宋世言宗譜者二家，曰廬陵歐陽氏，曰眉山蘇氏。今其法綦然覈也，亦可倣而行之否？多士慕古昔而尊本源，懷敦睦之思，幸爲我言其槩。
問：天下之法，久則必敝，敝則必通其變。變通所以救敝也，然敝或從生焉。然則法終不可變乎？利害得失，固相倚伏而不可絕乎？將翟翦所謂「舉大木」者乎？抑用餡者之殊乎？智者之所以搤掔深思、諏咨而求也。往者，畫里輪年而事，民民患
translation_en:
Thus the Han compiled registers of the Ten Thousand Surnames (Wanxing) alongside treatises on Clans and Lineages (Shizu); the Wei established Impartial Judges (Zhongzheng) and thereupon instituted the Nine Ranks (Jiupin); and from the Jin and Liu-Song onward, people vied with one another in exalting them. There were the Genealogies of the Hundred Families (Baijia pu), the Registers of the Hundred Officials (Baiguan die), and the Treatises on Official Clans (Guanshi zhi). By the time of the Li-Tang dynasty, this practice flourished even more: treatises and records of Clans and Lineages (Shizu) and Surname Genealogies (Xingxi) were handed down together; works of the Yiguan and Yongtai eras had prolific and extravagant headings and sections; and the Summary of Rhymes (Yunlüe) and Rhyme Genealogies (Yunpu) further distinguished clans by pronunciation. Regarding all works of this sort, commentators have found much to praise and blame. From what I have heard, do not the words of the genealogists also have ancient models that they follow and transmit? Why then are they so at variance with antiquity? Gentlemen sigh with longing when they think of the ancient lineage system (zongfa), yet circumstances no longer permit it to be practiced; therefore, they devote their attention to genealogical registers. Formerly, during the Song dynasty, there were two masters who spoke of clan genealogies: Ouyang of Luling (Ouyang Xiu 歐陽修) and Su of Meishan (Su Xun 蘇洵). Today their methods remain exceedingly rigorous and verifiable—can they also be imitated and put into practice, or not? You many scholars admire remote antiquity, revere fundamental origins, and cherish thoughts of kinship harmony; pray set forth the general outlines for me.

Question: When the laws of the empire have been in place for a long time, they inevitably deteriorate; when they deteriorate, one must adapt and change them. Adaptation and change are the means to remedy deterioration, yet new abuses sometimes arise therefrom. Can it be, then, that laws ultimately ought never to be changed? Do benefit and harm, success and failure, inherently depend upon and lurk within one another so that they can never be severed? Is it as Zhai Jian 翟翦 spoke of "lifting a great timber"? Or does the difference lie in those who apply the法 [? transcription has 餡, likely a misprint for 法 "laws"]? This is why the wise clench their wrists in deep reflection, inquiring and consulting in search of an answer. In the past, administrative communities (li) were demarcated to serve in rotation by year, and the people suffered…

title: 萬曆七年浙江鄉試錄
text:
苦之故通計而賦之以弛民法良便也
而不便者復隨而擿其弊壤賦不均百
姓喁喁見病故有丈量均田之令意至
勤也無何而病者又見告矣夫彼擿者
告者寧無當乎然誠以是二者較之往
事終焉孰得也鄉約所以訓俗也而行
之不效世見詆焉迂保甲所以輯衆也
而法未徧行民巳厭其擾然則是二者
卒不可行乎嗟夫井田封建先王之良
===
法也而時移勢變訟議紛紜古今一轍
所從來矣寧渠如前所云四事乎惟茲
四者子鄉黨父兄之計而異日者諸生
為吏之師也願聞所宜罷行之畫
punctuated: 苦之，故通計而賦之以弛民，法良便也；而不便者復隨而擿其弊。壤賦不均，百姓喁喁見病，故有丈量均田之令，意至勤也；無何而病者又見告矣。夫彼擿者、告者，寧無當乎？然誠以是二者較之往事，終焉孰得也？鄉約所以訓俗也，而行之不效，世見詆焉迂；保甲所以輯衆也，而法未徧行，民巳厭其擾。然則是二者卒不可行乎？嗟夫！井田、封建，先王之良法也，而時移勢變，訟議紛紜，古今一轍，所從來矣，寧渠如前所云四事乎？惟茲四者，子鄉黨父兄之計，而異日者諸生為吏之師也，願聞所宜罷行之畫。
translation_en: …suffered bitterly from it, and so an overall calculation was made to levy a unified tax in order to give the people relief [the Single Whip method]. This law was truly convenient, yet those who found it inconvenient soon followed by pointing out its abuses. Because land taxes were unequal and the common people were clamoring in distress, there was the order to survey and equalize the fields; the intention was most diligent, yet before long those who suffered from it again lodged complaints. Now, could those who point out abuses and those who lodge complaints be entirely without justification? Yet if we genuinely compare these two measures with past practices, which in the end is more advantageous? The community compact (xiangyue) is a means to instruct popular customs, yet when practiced without effect, the world disparages it as impractical; the mutual security system (baojia) is a means to bring order to the multitude, yet before the law has been universally implemented, the people already resent its disruption. Does this mean, then, that these two measures ultimately cannot be carried out? Alas! The well-field (jingtian) and feudal (fengjian) systems were fine laws of the former kings, yet as times changed and circumstances shifted, debates and criticisms multiplied in confusion. Ancient and modern times follow the same track—it has been this way for a long time! How could it be limited only to the four matters mentioned above? Yet these four matters are the concern of the fathers and elder brothers in your own home communities, and will serve as models for you scholars when you become officials in the future. I wish to hear your plans regarding what ought to be abolished and what ought to be put into practice.
